name: 韭研公社文章爬取
description: 爬取一篇韭研公社文章的标题与正文（最多8000字符）。需要微信登录态；积分/权限内容可能仅返回可见部分。

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: 文章链接（jiuyangongshe.com/a/<id>）；不填则在当前标签页爬取

args.expression:
(async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const target=want('$url');const isArt=()=>/jiuyangongshe\.com/a//.test(location.href);if(target&&location.href!==target&&!isArt()){location.href=target;const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!isArt())await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));}if(!isArt())return {ok:false,error:'not-article-page',hint:'请传入公社文章链接（jiuyangongshe.com/a/<id>）'};await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2500));const body=document.querySelector('.detail-container');if(!body)return {ok:false,error:'no-content',hint:'正文未渲染，可能需要登录或积分权限'};const t=document.title.replace(/-?\s*韭研公社.*$/,'').trim();return {ok:true,title:t,content:body.innerText.replace(/
{3,}/g,'

').trim().slice(0,8000),url:location.href};})()
